title: Paper plane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="paperLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f5f5fa"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d8ddf0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="paperFold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8ebf7"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c0c8e0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="paperDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#aab4d4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8892b8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="coral" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8a7a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0564a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow / trail -->
  <path d="M10 70 Q25 60 38 56" stroke="#7a86b0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M14 78 Q28 68 42 62" stroke="#9aa4c8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- main plane body -->
  <path d="M30 52 L85 30 L62 62 Z" fill="url(#paperLight)" stroke="#b8c0dc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- top wing highlight -->
  <path d="M30 52 L85 30 L70 48 Z" fill="url(#paperFold)"/>
  <!-- bottom wing -->
  <path d="M30 52 L62 62 L52 72 Z" fill="url(#paperDark)"/>
  <!-- center crease -->
  <path d="M30 52 L62 62" stroke="#c8d0e8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M30 52 L72 44" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- nose fold accent -->
  <path d="M62 62 L85 30 L75 55 Z" fill="#eef0f8" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- smiling face on body -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="52" r="2.2" fill="#3a4466"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="49" r="2.2" fill="#3a4466"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="48.7" cy="51.2" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57.7" cy="48.2" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47 55 Q52 59 58 55" stroke="#3a4466" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="56" r="1.4" fill="#ff9c8f" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="52.5" r="1.4" fill="#ff9c8f" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- little motion lines -->
  <path d="M22 46 Q28 48 30 52" stroke="#c8d0e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M20 54 Q26 55 30 57" stroke="#c8d0e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- small star sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffd166">
    <path d="M80 20 L81 23 L84 23 L82 25 L83 28 L80 26 L77 28 L78 25 L76 23 L79 23 Z" opacity="0.9"/>
    <path d="M68 16 L68.5 17.5 L70 17.5 L69 18.5 L69.3 20 L68 19 L66.7 20 L67 18.5 L66 17.5 L67.5 17.5 Z" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
</svg>
